endpoints.description: Fetch one or more series by ID over a year range (JSON body)
Fetch a single series by ID (limited, no key features)

limits.notes: Registered v2: 500 queries/day, 50 series/query, up to 20 years/query. Unregistered v1: 25 queries/day, 25 series, 10 years. Quota is per key — multiplexing risk, monitor usage.

llmDocs.summary: BLS time series: CPI (inflation), unemployment, employment (CES), wages, JOLTS, PPI. POST series IDs with a year range, get back data points.
llmDocs.queryGuide: POST JSON to /timeseries/data/ with {seriesid:[...], startyear, endyear, registrationkey}. Series IDs are structured codes (e.g. CUUR0000SA0 = CPI-U all items; LNS14000000 = unemployment rate). Set catalog/calculations/annualaverage flags as needed.
gotchas: Series IDs are opaque coded strings; wrong code returns an empty series, not an error.
Max 20 years per request — split longer ranges.
Daily quota is 500 and per-key; cache results and avoid re-pulling unchanged history.
